ai.title: Opioid Overdose Reversal Medications: Medicare and Medicaid Enrollees Generally Had Coverage in Selected Recent Years
ai.raw_summary: What GAO Found Naloxone and nalmefene, the two types of opioid overdose reversal medications, are available as both injections and nasal sprays and as generic and brand versions. Naloxone is also available in low and high doses. Low-dose naloxone nasal sprays have been available for over-the-counter (OTC) use since 2023. GAO’s analysis of federal data show that all enrollees of Medicare Part D and Medicaid had coverage of some form of naloxone in 2025 and 2024, respectively, while coverage of nalmefene—a newer and longer acting medication—was less common (see figure). Medicare Part D Enrollee and Medicaid Coverage of Opioid Reversal Medications Note: For the purposes of this report, GAO identified states as having Medicaid coverage if there was utilization of opioid overdose reversal medications; other states may have coverage but no utilization of these medications. Medicare Part D out-of-pocket costs for both drugs varied by formulation and brand or generic status, with the lowest costs for generic naloxone injections, ranging from a $3 to $10 median copay. The highest out-of-pocket costs ranged from a 25 to 35 percent median coinsurance for brand high-dose naloxone and nalmefene nasal sprays. For example, for a covered nasal spray that costs $150, enrollees would pay about $38 or $53, depending on whether their coinsurance rate was 25 percent or 35 percent. ai.title: Democracy Assistance: State Department Should Improve Congressional Notification of Its Use of Certain Legal Authorities
ai.raw_summary: What GAO Found Federal law contains certain provisions, known as notwithstanding authorities, that allow agencies to provide funding that would otherwise be restricted. Historically, the annual appropriations act has required agencies to notify Congress if they intend to use a notwithstanding authority to provide assistance in countries where U.S. law prohibits U.S. funding. In fiscal years (FY) 2023 and 2024, the joint explanatory statement (JES) accompanying the act included additional directions for providing such notifications. In July 2025 the Secretary of State announced that USAID had ceased to implement foreign assistance. State assumed certain former USAID functions, including some democracy programs, and will submit congressional notifications related to future democracy assistance. While Congress has not included a JES with directions for providing information on notwithstanding authorities with every appropriations act, it did so in fiscal year 2026 and may continue to do so in the future. GAO’s review of 37 State congressional notifications for FYs 2023 and 2024 funding found that 36 of the notifications do not address one of three criteria, specified in Section 7015(c) of the FYs 2023 and 2024 appropriations acts or in their JESs, for reporting the use of notwithstanding authorities. ai.title: K-12 Education: Data Show That Less than Half of Students Were Ready for Kindergarten in Selected States
ai.raw_summary: What GAO Found In general, GAO’s review of 11 studies found that publicly funded preschool programs contribute to children’s readiness for kindergarten in literacy, math, or both. Specifically, 10 studies found positive associations between preschool programs and kindergarten literacy scores, and seven of the studies that assessed math scores also found positive associations with these scores. One study did not find evidence of an effect in either area. These studies also suggest that public preschool programs affect student demographic groups differently. For example, one study found that English learners benefitted more from a public preschool program in Virginia than non-English learners. It also found that children from lower-income families benefited more from attending the program than children from higher-income families. GAO’s analysis of kindergarten entry assessment (KEA) data from five selected states also found a link between preschool, certain demographic factors, and kindergarten readiness. School districts with higher enrollment in public or private preschool were associated with higher kindergarten readiness in three of five selected states, according to GAO’s regression analyses. In addition, higher-poverty school districts were associated with lower readiness in four states. ai.title: Commission preliminarily finds TikTok’s ‘For You’ feed in breach of Digital Services Act for harmful ‘rabbit holes’ effect
ai.source_name: 歐盟執委會 數位政策
ai.via: 歐盟執委會 數位政策
ai.raw_summary: Commission preliminarily finds TikTok’s ‘For You’ feed in breach of Digital Services Act for harmful ‘rabbit holes’ effect Anonymous (not verified) Fri, 11/06/2026 - 12:09 The European Commission has preliminarily found TikTok in breach of the Digital Services Act (DSA) for the so-called ‘rabbit hole effect’ of its recommender system. TikTok's ‘For You' feed shows users a continuous stream of personalised videos, even when those are related to mental health struggles and body image. The more a user interacts with a certain type of content, the more TikTok's ‘For You' feed algorithm recommends similar content. This design can be harmful when such endless and repeated exposure involves, for example, content about sadness, isolation or body image. These ‘rabbit holes' can have a detrimental impact on users' mental health, especially that of vulnerable adults and minors. These preliminary findings focus on both risk assessment and mitigation measures. Read the full details in the press release Find further information about: Supervision of the designated very large online platforms and search engines under DSA Digital Services Act - main aspects of the regulation User rights under the Digital Services Act - an overview Related topics Online platforms and e-commerce DSA - Digital Services Act

trade.title: 經濟部貿易救濟審議會就我對韓國及中國大陸非方向性電磁鋼品反傾銷案與對中國大陸特定鋁箔落日調查案作成產業損害之肯定認定
trade.source_name: 經濟部國際貿易署 新聞
trade.via: 經濟部國際貿易署 新聞
trade.raw_summary: 經濟部今（9）日召開貿易救濟審議會，會中就我國對韓國及中國大陸冷軋扁軋非方向性電磁鋼品反傾銷案，以及對中國大陸特定鋁箔課徵反傾銷稅屆滿5年之落日調查案等2案之產業損害調查結果進行審議，前者最後認定國內產業遭受實質損害；後者認定國內產業損害可能因停止課徵反傾銷稅而繼續或再發生。 經濟部表示，就電磁鋼品案調查發現，韓國及中國大陸涉案貨物進口量大幅增加且持續降價，自112年起以低於國產品價格銷售，國內產業為維持競爭力被迫跟進減價，惟因減價幅度不及涉案傾銷貨物而流失客戶，導致生產量、產能利用率、內銷量、市場占有率等經濟指標全面下滑，並自113年起內銷出現虧損且逐步擴大。雖然國內產業114年相關經濟指標一度改善，但115年上半年再度轉弱，顯示涉案傾銷貨物進口已對國內產業造成顯著不利影響。 另針對中國大陸特定鋁箔落日調查案，調查發現，課徵反傾銷稅期間涉案貨物進口量雖有減少，但仍以低價與國產品競爭，使得國內產業營運狀況略有好轉後又再度惡化。復考量中國大陸鋁箔產能過剩且出口能力強勁，加上越來越多國家對其鋁箔採行貿易救濟措施或提高關稅，已嚴重限縮其外銷市場。若我國停止課徵反傾銷稅，涉案貨物可能再度低價大量出口至鄰近且其已建立行銷通路的我國市場。在國內需求尚未好轉、產業體質仍然脆弱的情況下，可能使我國特定鋁箔產業之損害繼續或再發生。 經濟部表示，上述2案產業損害認定結果將通知財政部，並由該部提交關稅稅率審議小組審議是否課徵及繼續課徵反傾銷稅。該2案之產業損害調查報告公開版可於今年12月9日起至貿易署網站（網址：https://www.trade.gov.tw/）「經貿往來」/「我國採行之貿易救濟措施」/「案件調查」項下之「調查報告」下載。 貿易署發言人：胡副署長 聯絡電話：02-2397-7109、02-2397-7178、0966-525-106 業務聯絡人：綜合企劃組邱組長 聯絡電話：02-2397-7361

trade.title: 進口人無償或減價提供賣方用於生產及銷售進口貨物之物品或勞務，應計入完稅價格申報
trade.source_name: 財政部關務署 新聞
trade.via: 財政部關務署 新聞
trade.raw_summary: 海關近來接獲進口人詢問國外自備模具之費用是否應計入完稅價格等問題，關務署表示，倘進口人有「無償」或「減價」提供賣方用於生產或銷售該進口貨物之物品或勞務，應主動將其計入完稅價格向海關申報，避免因未申報相關費用而須補稅或送查價，影響通關速度。 關務署說明，依據關稅法第29條規定，進口貨物之完稅價格以交易價格為課徵關稅基礎，為確保完稅價格核估之正確性，若進口貨物之實付或應付價格中，未計入下列由買方無償或減價提供賣方用於生產或銷售該貨物之物品及勞務，應將其合理攤計之金額或減價金額計入完稅價格： 一、組成該進口貨物之原材料、零組件及其類似品。 二、生產該進口貨物所需之工具、鑄模、模型及其類似品。 三、生產該進口貨物所消耗之材料。 四、生產該進口貨物在國外之工程、開發、工藝、設計及其類似勞務。 關務署提醒，倘進口人有此類產銷協助費用，應提供買賣合約書、商業發票、付款證明等必要文件供海關審核，若無客觀及可計量之資料，海關將依關稅法第29條第4項規定無法按交易價格核估其完稅價格，籲請進口人注意，避免海關查核時發現短（漏）報，影響自身權益。 新聞稿聯絡人：賴科長 聯絡電話：（02）25505500分機2703

trade.title: 401(k) Plan Investments: DOL Can Take Steps to Prepare for Expected Private Equity Growth
trade.raw_summary: What GAO Found Private equity is one type of investment within a broad, undefined category called alternative assets. It differs from publicly traded equity in who can invest in it, how it is valued, and what disclosures are required, among other things. GAO’s review of selected research papers that analyzed private equity investment fund performance found no consensus on the performance of private equity relative to publicly traded equity, which is an important consideration when making investment decisions. GAO found a range of performance findings among research papers we reviewed, as well as ranges in data analyzed, benchmarks for performance comparisons, and methodologies. For example, one group of papers found that private equity funds outperformed publicly traded equity for the sample of funds they analyzed during the specific time-periods studied. The size of the overperformance varied widely. In one paper the benchmarks did not include a risk premium, the excess return that some experts believe a private equity investment should provide to justify higher investment risks. Another group of papers found that private equity funds underperformed publicly traded equity during the time-period studied, accounting for the underlying risk or fees, which can be higher for private equity than for publicly traded equity products.
